title: Command
description: A command the Task Orchestrator receives. Per-command expectations (enforced by the TO, not this schema): submit needs `payload` or `workflow_id`; cancel needs `run_id`; pause and resume are task-based and need `run_id` and `task_id`.

run_id.description: The workflow run being targeted. Required for CANCEL/PAUSE/RESUME. For START it is optional; the TO generates one if absent.

task_id.description: The task within the run to target. Required for PAUSE/RESUME, which act on a single task rather than the whole workflow.

workflow_id.description: START-by-reference: id of a workflow definition the TO already holds.

payload.description: START-by-value: the inline workflow definition (see workflow.schema.json).
